overview: This paper introduces a fractional-order Spiking Neural Network (f-SNN) framework that replaces integer-order ODEs with fractional-order ODEs to capture long-term dependencies and non-Markovian behavior in biological neurons, validating its effectiveness and robustness on neuromorphic vision and graph learning tasks.

modules.name: Fractional Derivative Numerical Solvers
modules.description: Implementation of mathematical engines for fractional calculus, including Caputo and Grünwald-Letnikov derivative definitions, and numerical discretization schemes such as Adams-Bashforth-Moulton and forward Euler for fractional ODEs.

modules.name: Fractional Spiking Neuron Dynamics
modules.description: Implementation of the core f-IF and f-LIF neuron models, handling the charge phase with fractional dynamics, threshold comparison for spike generation, and membrane potential reset mechanisms (soft/hard reset).

modules.name: Historical Memory Kernel Engine
modules.description: Management of the causal memory kernel coefficients derived from fractional derivatives, implementing efficient history convolution methods including FFT-based full-memory convolution and the short-memory approximation with a sliding window.

modules.name: Surrogate Gradient Suite
modules.description: Implementation of differentiable surrogate functions (Sigmoid, Arctan, Piecewise Linear, Gaussian) to approximate the gradient of the non-differentiable Heaviside step function during backpropagation.

modules.name: Neuromorphic Data Preprocessor
modules.description: Pipeline for processing event-based camera data, converting asynchronous event streams into frame-like representations compatible with SNN inputs, including normalization and resizing.

modules.name: Graph Data Spike Encoder
modules.description: Conversion of static graph node features into temporal spike trains using Poisson encoding strategies to interface with spiking graph neural networks.

modules.name: Vision f-SNN Architecture Wrapper
modules.description: Integration modules to replace standard activation layers in vision backbones (CNN, ResNet, Spiking Transformer) with fractional spiking neurons, handling the reshape and integration of temporal dimensions.

modules.name: Graph f-SNN Architecture Wrapper
modules.description: Integration modules to replace integer-order LIF neurons in graph neural networks (SGCN, DRSGNN, MSG) with f-LIF neurons, maintaining compatibility with positional encodings and message passing frameworks.

modules.name: SNN Training Workflow Manager
modules.description: Control logic for the SNN training loop, managing timestep-unrolled forward passes, surrogate gradient-based backward passes, loss computation (mean over time), and optimization steps.

modules.name: Input Perturbation Generators
modules.description: Functions to apply controlled corruptions to inputs for robustness testing, including Gaussian noise injection, spatial occlusion blocks, temporal jitter, temporal truncation, frame dropping, and graph edge/feature masking.

modules.name: Robustness Scoring Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluation logic to calculate model performance degradation under various perturbation intensities and compute the aggregated weighted robustness score as defined in the experimental section.

modules.name: Energy Efficiency Analyzer
modules.description: Module to estimate theoretical hardware energy consumption based on synaptic operations (accounting for firing rates and FLOPs) and intrinsic neuron costs (comparison logic for integer vs. fractional dynamics).

modules.name: Experiment Runner & Sweep Manager
modules.description: Utilities for managing hyperparameter configurations (fractional order, memory window size, neuron thresholds), logging, and running ablation studies across different datasets and architectural backbones.
